name: Fresh distinctive-token router with conditional temporal appearance fallback
question: Can the already frozen appearance branch safely resolve the sole fresh lexical NO_MATCH so that the fixed conditional router covers both fresh targets without a wrong candidate?

routing_contract.lexical_unique_match: Emit the fresh distinctive-token SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY candidate.
routing_contract.lexical_no_match: Run the unchanged temporal appearance branch; emit only if its frozen score and margin gates both pass, otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
routing_contract.lexical_wrong_or_ambiguous: Emit UNKNOWN and do not permit appearance to override a lexical conflict.
routing_contract.efficiency: Encode fresh query frames only for the one sealed lexical NO_MATCH; references for both new targets are required to preserve the full thirteen-target counterfactual roster.

accept_contract.source: Unchanged minima frozen from the original four consumed positives before every open-set and transfer panel.
accept_contract.rule: Emit SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY only when the sequence aggregate has unique top-1 and meets both score and margin thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.

execution_rule: Run exactly once. Do not tune score, margin, lexical rules, roster, or panel after seeing the result.

claim_boundary.allowed: Fresh same-provider Development evidence for the fixed lexical-then-conditional-appearance router on exactly two target-way/item-disjoint, pixel- and OCR-unseen targets across two capture producers in a thirteen-target closed roster.
not_allowed: independent, provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, distribution-shift, deployment, or safety confirmation
OCR or appearance candidates proving exact physical identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, portal ownership, or entrance ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or deployment performance
